name: @red-cup-engineering/proof-pathing-services-section
description: Owns canonical file-leg admission, normalization, and readout for Proof-Path Addressing.

scripts.check: node --check lib/law.mjs && npm run check --prefix services/proof-path-structuration-service

x-agentic-metro-enterprise.admission: a declared file-boundary codec and a candidate path whose earned segments can be checked against one typed address term
x-agentic-metro-enterprise.refusal: an untyped host string, an unearned segment, a non-canonical rendering, a displaced derivation, or a request for registry or cross-protocol authority
